name: Total War: New World
summary: Total War: New World is a massive overhaul mod for Rome 2, along the lines of DeI and Radious. Instead of being focused on historical events, it takes place in an alternate reality of the ancient world. With various new cultures, factions, effects, buildings, units, technologies, UI visuals, and major overhauls to the campaign and battle AI, this’ll be a new experience for even the most hardcore Total War players!
